title: The towers defining integral pullback and completed tensor product are invariant under change of K-flat resolution
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and put $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ ($n\geq1$) [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $W$ let $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}=\varprojlim_n(A_{E,n})_W$ be the completed coefficient sheaf on the small pro-etale site $W_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with projections $\pi_n$, restriction of scalars $\operatorname{Res}_n$ along $\pi_n$ and derived category $D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. For a tower $(C_n,t_n:C_{n+1}\to C_n)_{n\geq1}$ of complexes of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}$-modules write $\operatorname{Rlim}^{\mathrm c}(C_\bullet)$ for the complex $\operatorname{Cone}(1-s)[-1]$, where $1-s:\prod_nC_n\to\prod_nC_n$, $(c_n)\mapsto(c_n-t_n(c_{n+1}))$, on the termwise products [lem-weil-proetale-countable-products-exact]. For a complex $P$ of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}$-modules put $P_n=P\otimes_{\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}}(A_{E,n})_W$ (termwise change of rings [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]), with the maps $P_{n+1}\to P_n$ induced by $A_{E,n+1}\twoheadrightarrow A_{E,n}$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] and $f^*=f^{-1}(-)\otimes_{f^{-1}(A_{E,n})_Y}(A_{E,n})_X$ the module inverse image on sheaves of $(A_{E,n})_Y$-modules [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. For complexes $P$ on $Y$ and $P,Q$ on $W$ define

$$
 T_f(P)=\operatorname{Rlim}^{\mathrm c}_n\operatorname{Res}_nf^*(P_n),\qquad
 T(P,Q)=\operatorname{Rlim}^{\mathrm c}_n\operatorname{Res}_n\bigl(P_n\otimes_{(A_{E,n})_W}Q_n\bigr),
$$

with transition maps induced by those of $P_\bullet$, $Q_\bullet$. Then: (1) if $u:P\to P'$ and $v:Q\to Q'$ are quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,-}$-modules with flat terms [def-pc-kflat-complex], the induced maps $T_f(P)\to T_f(P')$ and $T(P,Q)\to T(P',Q')$ are quasi-isomorphisms; (2) consequently, choosing for every object a K-flat resolution with flat terms [lem-pc-kflat-resolution], $K\mapsto T_f(P_K)$ and $(M,N)\mapsto T(P_M,P_N)$ define functors $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)\to D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ and $D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)^2\to D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$, independent of the resolutions up to unique isomorphism of functors, and each value is a derived limit [def-weil-derived-limit] of the corresponding tower in $D(-_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$.
